preconditions.description: The graph has at least one vertex and at least n-1 edges (connected), with no more than 200,000 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects distinct vertices within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge weight is a positive integer up to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(u_i, v_i), max(u_i, v_i)) for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: The graph has no multiple edges (each unordered pair appears at most once).
The graph is connected (there is a path between any two vertices).

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of operations (edge weight increases by 1) required to make the MST unique while preserving its total cost k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= new_w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i, new_w_i in zip(edges, operations))
postconditions.description: No edge weight exceeds 10^9 after operations.
The total cost of the MST remains equal to the initial MST cost k.
The MST is unique in the modified graph.
